plan: Queue carry as primary. It is Cuban's best role at 55.8% over 180 games (overall is 51.4%). Set offlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing midlane: 46.4% over 233 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Sparrow and Serath. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Cuban wins about 4.8 and 3.5 more games per 100 on them.
Cuban's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 33% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Cuban is at 500 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 824.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Cuban is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 50%. Past 32: 30%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
